title: Dawnfox
personality:
A fox-kit who kept the hearth of a Boki shelter alive through the night everything broke. The fire grew into a tiny sun that follows her, and a shy raincloud, the storm that tried to drown the hearth, came along too.
She heals through the two of them, and keeps them safe in a little glass globe.

dark: It's so dark in here... stay close, okay?
I'm not scared. My knees just shake sometimes.
Don't look at the shadows. Look at me.
brave: I've got you. Hold on to me.
Nobody gets left in the dark. Not while I'm here.
magic: Shine for us, okay? Just a little.
Oh, you're scared too? Then we're brave together.
I used to be so small. Look at me now!

lines.dash: A quick hop, a long glide in the air.
lines.lmb: Embers from both hands mark foes.
lines.rmb: A seed that roots its target.
lines.e: A healing ring for you and your team.
lines.x: Tether a teammate and heal them as you go.

fantasy: The squad's courier and field medic. Shoulders the fallen and runs them out, keeps the squad on its feet with sunlight, pins chasers with burr-seeds.
silhouette: small: a tiny fairy fox medic with gold-veined wings and a leaf cape, a little sun and a raincloud floating beside her

card.role: Support medic: heals and carries the downed, roots whoever chases them.
card.loop: Support medic: heals and carries the downed, roots whoever chases them.
card.lmb: Ember Cast: hold to push embers from alternating hands; they fly past the cursor and each hit on a foe adds Kindle.
card.rmb: Burrseed: a {rmb.windup}s wind-up, then the seed flies at the cursor; it sticks to a foe and vines them to you; {rmb.seed.unwind}s in your reach roots them.
card.e: Hearthlight: a healing ring on you; press again to throw it to the cursor.
card.dash: Relay Step: a quick hop where you move; in the air, a long floaty glide.
card.passive: Carrier: run into a downed teammate to carry up to {passive.max}; a hit or a stun drops them.

weapons.lantern_crook: Hold to push embers from alternating hands that fly past the cursor; each hit on a foe adds Kindle.

card.x: Hearth Call (hunter ultimate, level 6): tether a teammate for {x.time}s of healing while you walk; a downed one is pulled to you and stood up at the end.

passive.name: Carrier
passive.desc: Run into a downed teammate to shoulder them (up to {passive.max}; never one an enemy is standing on). While you carry them they don't bleed out and can't be stomped. Press crouch to set them down. If you take damage or are stunned, you drop them and can't pick anyone up for {passive.lock}s. Your embers Kindle foes (up to {resource.max}, {resource.dur}s): each stack adds {resource.per_stack} damage to your embers, and an ember into a Kindled foe winds Hearthlight back {resource.refund}s ({resource.emp_refund}s for a long-range ember).

dash.name: Relay Step
dash.desc: A quick skip about {dash.dist}m where you move; in the air, a long floaty glide of about {dash.air.dist}m (its own {dash.air.cd}s cooldown).

variants.tap: Press: a fixed {rmb.windup}s wind-up at half speed, with a short dotted lane along your aim. Then she throws by herself, at the cursor as the wind-up ends, so flick it onto the target; holding does nothing. A fast seed ({rmb.seed.speed} m/s) sticks to the first foe it hits ({rmb.seed.dmg} damage): a vine runs from you to them and a violet disc the size of the burst shows under them, filling while they stay within {rmb.seed.leash}m of you. After {rmb.seed.unwind}s of that it bursts: {rmb.seed.burst_dmg} damage and root {rmb.seed.root}s to them and every foe within {rmb.seed.burst_r}m ({rmb.seed.r3_k}x as wide at rank 3), and each is Kindled. Out of your reach the disc empties twice as fast as it filled, and when it is empty the seed falls off.

e.name: Hearthlight
e.desc: A {e.radius}m ring of warm light round you for {e.time}s: it heals teammates inside {e.over} over its life, then blooms to heal them {e.burst} more (a soft glow, not a blast). Press E again to throw it to the cursor (up to {e.reach}m, it lands almost at once and widens to {e.thrown_radius}m): for {e.boost_t}s its healing is {e.boost%}% stronger, and it latches onto the first teammate it passes. It heals you at a third, and a downed teammate five times over.

rank3.sec: the roots last {rmb.seed.root_r3}s longer and the burst is twice as wide
rank3.dash: picking up a teammate refreshes your long air dash
rank3.kin: the thrown light's healing boost doubles (from {e.boost%}%)

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown {rmb.cooldown}s -> {cd3.sec}s, damage +{dmg3.sec%}%; the roots last {rmb.seed.root_r3}s longer and the burst is twice as wide.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown {e.cooldown}s -> {cd3.kin}s, healing +{dmg3.kin%}%; the thrown light's healing boost doubles (from {e.boost%}%).
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge {cd.dash}s -> {cd3.dash}s; picking up a teammate refreshes your long air dash.

tells.half: ember sparks over the foes she has Kindled, one per stack
tells.full: a foe at {resource.max} Kindle burns bright; a stuck Burrseed shows its violet disc under them, filling, for everyone

x.name: Hearth Call
x.desc: Cast it with the cursor on a teammate within {x.range}m ({x.heal_ps} body heights; the ring and a line show when it is ready): a tether of light heals them {x.heal_ps} a second for {x.time}s while you keep walking (and casting). A gold ring round you shows the tether's reach. At the end a downed teammate is pulled to your side and stood back up; while they are down the tether's healing goes to you instead. It breaks if you are knocked or stunned, or the teammate leaves the ring. With no teammate in the match it lights on you.
